title: The roundabout and the metronome

data.source: The cos-potential rotor of MATHEMATICS.md R4 with a periodic outside push, 1601 values of the steady push tau.

prediction: Pushed in rhythm, the rotor locks: its turns per push stick at 0, 1/2, 1 and 2 over whole ranges of the steady push, the staircase never goes down, and the cut count is exactly twice the turns. On the zero step there are no cuts at all.
baseline: Circle-map theory (Arnold 1961) and the Shapiro-step widths 2A|J_n(eps/w)| of the driven Josephson junction.
why: The rotor locks exactly as circle-map theory says, and the cut count is twice the rotation number. The step widths matched the Bessel estimate. The half step I predicted is not there: for this equation only whole-number steps exist, which the textbooks already say. CRR names the parts but predicts no step, so it restates.
